title: Nik's Craftables - Armor Trims
description: Adds crafting recipes for armor trims. Made for players who don't care about the rarity of certain items.
body:
![purple block letters that reads "craftables"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds crafting recipes for armor trims and the netherite upgrade template! For when you really do not care about the rarity and just want some cool clothes. Unlock recipes by crafting a knowledge book.

## Knowledge Book Recipe
![craft a knowledge book with a book and an emerald](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d5b4a77a1353c0362196fcd23e7dbaea1fb016e.png)
